from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyDeferredTaxAsset(BaseModel):
    """Deferred tax asset information from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the financial document")
    deferred_tax_asset_amount: float | None = Field(description="The deferred tax asset amount reported, in the currency unit")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., '元' or 'CNY'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document containing the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_deferred_tax_assets: list[CompanyDeferredTaxAsset]
